lighting_shading.note: Pale wool highlights contrast with violet shading beneath rounded curls.

value_contrast.note: Bright wool separates clearly from the darker garden and sky.

color_palette.note: Yellow pillow and red checks punctuate cool blue-green surroundings.

composition_hierarchy.note: Reclining body leads diagonally toward the expressive upward-looking face.

shape_proportions.note: Oversized wool curls surround a small head and slender limbs.

rhythm_staging.note: Crossed legs and arms behind the head convey relaxed lounging.
